analysis:
Examined ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift head lines 1-1145 (both units). Changed behavior per patch: new optional workFIFOGate param (L194); decode now via Self.decodeInboundChatRequest returning request plus extensions (L349-351, 365), with templateControls, logprobsSpec and samplingOverrides taken from inbound.extensions (L398, 407, 410); awaitReleasedLoads gating around fast admission (L449-453); early releaseWorkFIFO after acceptance and registration for cold, non-mimo_v2 models (L562-566).

Security-relevant observations: (1) The decrypt, then reserved-metadata check (L321-328, rejects unauthenticated tool-schema metadata), then decode order is unchanged, so the metadata check still precedes parsing. Whether decodeInboundChatRequest preserves this and does not re-introduce reserved-metadata trust is in ProviderLoop+InboundDecode.swift, which is not supplied. (2) Error paths still log only generic strings, with no decrypted content or modelId in persistent logs (L361, 466, 576). (3) Cache scope still comes only from the coordinator-authenticated authenticatedCacheScope (L403), not caller fields, so T-041 scoping is unchanged. (4) Early releaseWorkFIFO occurs after acceptedLifecycleRequests.insert, requestToModel registration and cancellationRegistry.register, so the pin and cancel ownership exist before the FIFO release. The ordering and reentrancy semantics of releaseWorkFIFO and awaitReleasedLoads are in ProviderLoop+WorkFIFO.swift, which is not supplied. The concern is a possible availability/ordering issue (T-010/T-029), but there is no concrete evidence of a defect. (5) The encryption fail-closed path (T-008) is intact: precomputeSharedKey and emitSSE failures send an encryptionFailure error with no plaintext fallback. Remaining questions for integration: decodeInboundChatRequest equivalence with the prior decodeOpenAIRequest and extractChatTemplateControls (a parse differential could alter template controls or sampling overrides), and the FIFO gate release being idempotent on all early-exit paths (L575, 611, deadline paths). No qualifying findings from the supplied evidence.
